note: Regulatory milestones for the EU Digital Product Passport. Dates drive the live countdowns on /digital-product-passport, so every entry needs a real ISO date and a source anyone can check. Maintained by the 'DPP regulatory watch' Routine; see docs/strategy/persuasion-doctrine.md for the copy rules.

milestones.label: EU DPP registry rules adopted
milestones.detail: The Commission adopted Implementing Regulation (EU) 2026/1778 on the DPP registry on 16 July 2026.
milestones.badge: EU DPP registry rules adopted: Implementing Regulation (EU) 2026/1778

milestones.label: LMT, EV and industrial (>2 kWh) batteries
milestones.detail: Mandatory passport for LMT, EV and industrial (>2 kWh) batteries. Carbon footprint, recycled content and due diligence fields apply later, on their own dates (Commission FAQ Q7.2).

milestones.label: Textiles & Apparel (indicative)
milestones.detail: Indicative (ESPR working plan, delegated act not adopted). COM(2025) 187 lists textiles/apparel with an indicative 2027 adoption year; the delegated act will set the application date.

milestones.label: Furniture (indicative)
milestones.detail: Indicative (ESPR working plan, delegated act not adopted). COM(2025) 187 lists furniture with an indicative 2028 adoption year; the delegated act will set the application date.

milestones.label: Electronics & ICT Products (indicative)
milestones.detail: Indicative (ESPR working plan, delegated act not adopted). No adopted act sets a DPP date for smartphones, tablets or laptops; see the Ecodesign Working Plan 2025-2030, COM(2025) 187.
